001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.keyvalues.contributor;
002
003import java.util.Map;
004
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.KeyValues;
006import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
007import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor;
008import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
009import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
010
011/**
012 * Registers {@link DefaultKeyValues} as the
013 * {@link KeyValuesContributor.Source.Standard#DEFAULTS} key values source with the values
014 * of {@value DefaultKeyValues#DEFAULTS_PROPERTY}. Simply having this module on the
015 * classpath is enough.
016 */
017@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)
018public final class DefaultKeyValuesConfigurator implements RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator {
019
020        /**
021         * For service loader.
022         */
023        public DefaultKeyValuesConfigurator() {
024        }
025
026        @Override
027        public boolean configure(@SuppressWarnings("exports") LogConfig config, @SuppressWarnings("exports") Pass pass) {
028                Map<String, String> values = config.properties()
029                        .forKey(DefaultKeyValues.DEFAULTS_PROPERTY)
030                        .ofMap()
031                        .or(Map.of())
032                        .validateNow(DefaultKeyValuesConfigurator.class);
033                var defaults = DefaultKeyValues.of(config.serviceRegistry());
034                defaults.configure(KeyValues.of(values));
035                KeyValuesContributor.register(config.serviceRegistry(), KeyValuesContributor.Source.Standard.DEFAULTS,
036                                defaults);
037                return true;
038        }
039
040}
